title: Input equality formula evaluation
statement: For every finite Turing machine $M$ over Booleans, natural numbers $n,s$, and encoded rows $r,t$, the input-equality CNF formula evaluates to true on the assignment that reads each literal from $r$ or $t$ according to its row selector if and only if the input fields of $r$ and $t$ are equal.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over Booleans
